gpt-image-2.summary: A proper drawing — watercolour sky, ink construction lines, background towers reduced to loose verticals — with the building held exactly.

massing: pass
Curved-top tower, the volume behind and the stepped podium all hold their proportions and relative positions.
composition: Framing and viewpoint unchanged from the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Genuine media behaviour: watercolour bleed in the sky, uneven ink pressure, background towers drawn as loose vertical strokes rather than filtered geometry.
linework: Deliberate outline and construction linework carries the drawing throughout.
muted_tones: Restrained blues, tans and greens; nothing saturated.
concept_stage: Loose edges and unresolved background read as design-stage rather than a finished board.

gpt-image-1.5.summary: An accomplished pen-and-wash drawing that redesigned the building doing it — the second tower changes form and the frame tightens.

massing: partial
All volumes are present but reproportioned: the left tower reads shorter and wider, and the finned slab behind becomes a curved-top glass volume.
composition: Framing is tighter than the source, with the building filling more of the sheet and less sky above.
hand_drawn: pass
Clean pen-and-wash with genuine hand character in the linework and foliage.
linework: Strong, confident ink linework defines every plane.
muted_tones: Very restrained — largely white paper with grey and green washes.
concept_stage: Unfinished edges and open foreground read as an early-stage sketch.

Nano Banana 2.summary: A convincing marker sketch with hand-drawn cars and annotation-style labels; the volume behind the main tower is reshaped.

massing: partial
The curved tower and podium hold, but the finned slab behind becomes a jagged angular peak and the bronze box is redrawn as a wider tan volume.
composition: Viewpoint and the placement of elements in the frame follow the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Marker wash over ink with sketched cars, trees and street furniture — reads as a drawn sheet, not a filtered render.
linework: Visible construction and outline linework throughout the facades.
muted_tones: Restrained blue wash and tan blocks.
concept_stage: Loose and diagrammatic, with hand-lettered signage labels.

Nano Banana 2 Lite.summary: Not a sketch. The render is intact underneath a blue sky wash and a light line overlay — exactly the filtered-render failure the instruction rules out.

massing: pass
Geometry is untouched, which is unsurprising given the render itself is largely still there.
hand_drawn: fail
The building is still a photorealistic render: glass reflections, photographic planting and the green LED screen all survive unaltered. Only the sky carries a wash.
linework: Some added edge linework on the towers and line-drawn background blocks, but the podium has no drawn line at all.
muted_tones: Overall desaturated relative to the source.
concept_stage: Reads as a finished render with a filter, not an early-stage sketch.

Nano Banana Pro.summary: Textbook design-office hand: pen construction lines, ochre and grey marker, loose foliage — and the building held exactly.

massing: pass
Every volume holds silhouette, proportion and position, including the terrace cantilevers.
composition: Framing and viewpoint match the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Convincing pen-and-marker with wash bleed, uneven strokes and sketched trees; no trace of a filtered photograph.
linework: Confident visible construction linework leads the whole drawing.
muted_tones: Restrained ochres, greys and greens on white paper.
concept_stage: Open foreground and unresolved background read as exploratory.

FLUX.2 Max.summary: The most convincing media of the thirteen — coloured pencil with real paper tooth — on a slightly reshaped building.

massing: partial
The curved tower holds, but the volume behind becomes a blockier mass and the podium's stepping is simplified.
composition: Viewpoint and framing follow the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Outstanding coloured-pencil character — directional hatching in the sky, visible paper grain, pigment breaking over texture.
linework: Construction lines visible throughout, including overrun at the corners.
muted_tones: Desaturated pencil palette of greys, pale blues and dusty pinks.

Grok Imagine Image 2.0.summary: A clean marker-and-ink sketch that holds the building, delivered in about ten seconds.

massing: pass
Curved tower, the slab behind and the podium with its louvred box all hold position and proportion.
composition: Framing effectively unchanged from the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Marker over ink with paper texture, sketched trees and loosely drawn vehicles.
linework: Strong visible linework across facades and the background towers.
muted_tones: Muted greys, olives and warm tans.
concept_stage: Loose treatment with an open, lightly indicated foreground.

Seedream 5.0 Pro.summary: Marker and watercolour on white, building held exactly — one of the cleanest conversions in the task.

massing: pass
All volumes match the source in proportion and relative position.
hand_drawn: pass
Genuine marker and watercolour behaviour with visible stroke ends and pooling at the edges.
linework: Ink outlines define every volume, with visible overrun.
muted_tones: Soft blues, tans and greens throughout.
concept_stage: Loose foreground and lightly indicated background read as concept-stage.

Seedream 5.0 Lite.summary: Line-led ink drawing with light wash — the most technical hand here, and the building is untouched.

massing: pass
Every volume holds proportion and position, including the podium stepping and louvred box.
hand_drawn: pass
Reads as drawn rather than filtered — hand-hatched sky, sketched trees, wash applied loosely over line.
linework: Linework dominates: the drawing is built from outline and construction lines.
muted_tones: Mostly white paper with restrained blue and green washes.
concept_stage: Open and unresolved, clearly an early-stage drawing.

Qwen Image 3.summary: A graphite treatment applied over a render rather than a drawing made of line — the building survives, the medium does not convince.

massing: pass
Volumes, proportions and positions all hold.
hand_drawn: partial
Genuine graphite texture in the sky and line-drawn background towers, but the building core is still a rendered image — glass reflections and photographic planting show through the treatment.
linework: Some edge linework and drawn background blocks, but the mass is carried tonally rather than by line.
concept_stage: Reads as a rendered elevation given a pencil finish rather than an exploratory sketch.

Qwen Image 3 Pro.summary: The same render-underneath approach as Qwen Image 3, but with enough drawn sky and outline to read more convincingly as a sheet.

massing: pass
All volumes hold proportion and position.
hand_drawn: partial
Pencil hatching in the sky and sketched tower outlines are genuine, but the facades remain a rendered image beneath the treatment.
linework: Visible construction linework along tower edges, terraces and the background blocks.
concept_stage: Still quite resolved — closer to a finished rendering than a concept sketch.

MAI-Image-2.5.summary: A crisp technical pen-and-marker board. Well drawn and accurate, but finished enough to read as presentation rather than concept.

massing: pass
Every volume holds proportion and relative position.
composition: Framing and viewpoint match the source.
hand_drawn: pass
Genuine pen-and-marker with hand-drawn trees, vehicles and figures.
muted_tones: Building and ground are muted, but the sky wash is a notably saturated blue against an otherwise restrained sheet.
concept_stage: Tightly and evenly resolved across the whole sheet — reads as a finished presentation drawing rather than a concept-stage sketch.

MAI-Image-2.5 Pro.summary: Watercolour on cream parchment with ink construction lines — competition-board quality, and the building is exact.

massing: pass
All volumes match the source precisely, including terrace profiles and podium stepping.
hand_drawn: pass
True watercolour behaviour — pooling, soft edges, visible paper tone — over hand-inked line.
linework: Ink construction lines visible throughout, with deliberate overrun.
muted_tones: Warm parchment ground with restrained blue and green washes.
concept_stage: Loose sky and lightly indicated background keep it exploratory.
